question: Why do gods and great sages fail to know Krishna's manifestation?
premises: Arjuna accepts all Krishna says as true
gods and great sages do not know your manifestation
inference: Krishna's manifestation is known only by himself
uncertainties: fused token vidurdevā analyzed as one surface
plain_english: I think all this is true, O Kesava, that you speak to me; for neither gods nor great sages know your manifestation, O Lord.
